HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Hygiene and Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Hygiene and Safety.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Hygiene and Safety.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Food Hygiene and Safety.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Hygiene and Safety.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking? (1 mark)

   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking.

   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only
